title: SATNet: Bridging deep learning and logical reasoning using a differentiable satisfiability solver
source_evidence: Read original PDF section 3.1–3.3, equations 2–8 and Algorithms 1–2. Read author satnet/models.py MixingFunc.forward/backward and SATNet.forward, plus src/satnet_cpu.cpp mix_init/mix_kernel/mix_forward/mix_backward. Repository master resolved to 50897688eae47bf765c1d9ed9a7c6f5419d62a9a. Important implementation detail: current wrapper fixes k=32, unlike the paper's rank prescription; this must be recorded if used.
mechanism: Learn clause-factor matrix S; embed input probabilities as unit vectors relative to a truth direction; solve low-rank MAXSAT SDP by unit-sphere coordinate updates; decode latent output probabilities and differentiate the constrained stationary system.
osram_mapping: Project only already available Local256, Base512 and up to three active Gap512 vectors into probabilistic input propositions. Missing roles are removed from the input-variable index set and corresponding clause rows, never designated variables to reconstruct. Introduce separate latent reasoning-output propositions, solve the original SDP, decode them to an update of existing role vectors before Flat. Preserve causal memory read/write query and task loss. Clause learning uses downstream gradients only, with no proposition labels or auxiliary supervision.
substantive_difference: Global learned clause satisfaction with unit-sphere SDP optimization is not arity expansion/quantifier reduction, local gate truth tables, or Euclidean marginal-polytope projection. All SDP, probability encoding and implicit differentiation stages are required; a sigmoid proposition MLP alone would not qualify.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Might represent mutually incompatible combinations of current evidence through jointly learned constraints; no OSRAM improvement is established.
risks: Latent propositions may lack useful task semantics
SDP coordinate convergence and backward conditioning
Author native extensions are old; no dependency installation authorized
Must test all active-role masks without silently treating missing roles as unknown propositions

title: OptNet: Differentiable Optimization as a Layer in Neural Networks
source_evidence: Read PDF section 3, equations 2–6: positive-semidefinite QP, equality/inequality constraints and differentiated KKT complementarity. Read author cls/models.py OptNet, OptNetEq and LenetOptNet forward methods: Q=LL^T+epsilon I, learned G, h=Gz0+s0, QPFunction invocation. Pin af53140bfcace770f09d078bcd316f000fd0b854. qpth interior-point implementation itself was not inspected in this pass.
mechanism: Input-conditioned strongly convex quadratic minimization over a learned feasible polyhedron, with gradients through primal/dual KKT equations including active inequality constraints.
osram_mapping: Encode active current role vectors into the QP linear term and feasible anchor z0; parameterize positive slack explicitly, h=Gz0+softplus(s). Solve for a coupled latent feature vector with full Q and nontrivial learned G, decode to existing roles, then existing Flat. Inactive Gap contributes no data. Keep causal memory query and sole task loss unchanged. No reconstruction of missing roles.
substantive_difference: Learned cross-coordinate inequality feasibility and complementary slackness distinguish this from unconstrained energy aggregation, generic fixed points and gradient flow. SparseMAP optimizes on a fixed discrete-structure marginal polytope; this proposal learns a feasible feature-space polyhedron and quadratic coupling. Identity-Q simplex projection is expressly insufficient.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: A learned feasible region might suppress mutually inconsistent joint feature combinations; this remains an untested transfer hypothesis.
risks: Constraints may remain inactive, reducing the layer to an affine solve
Near-degenerate active sets can destabilize derivatives
Strictly positive slack is necessary; do not copy unconstrained s0 blindly
Full solver dependency and license audit still needed before implementation

title: What Game Are We Playing? End-to-end Learning in Normal and Extensive Form Games
source_evidence: Read PDF section 2.3 equations 5–9: entropy-regularized min-max, Newton KKT system and payoff derivative. Read author src/core/solve.py GRELogit.Solve and VerifySolution, and complete src/core/paynet.py ZSGSolver.forward/backward; backward solves saved KKT matrix and constructs two outer products. Pin 74b53d0e5ecf94513999cb8c2a351644086d39aa.
mechanism: Compute both players' coupled quantal-response mixed strategies for a learned zero-sum payoff matrix, by solving a strictly convex-concave entropy-regularized saddle problem and differentiating its KKT system.
osram_mapping: Concrete role-consensus game on active I subset of {Local256, Base512, Gap1_512, Gap2_512, Gap3_512}. Role-specific input adapters form proposal descriptors a_i and challenge descriptors b_j from the same existing vectors. Payoff P_ij=||a_i-b_j||^2; solve min_u max_v u^T P v + sum_i u_i log u_i - sum_j v_j log v_j on two active-role simplices. u selects a proposal mixture minimizing challenge-weighted discrepancy, while v emphasizes discordant existing evidence. Decode both sum_i u_i a_i and sum_j v_j b_j, plus their discrepancy, into existing role updates before Flat. This inner saddle objective is a layer definition, not an additional training loss. No corrupted view, target label, missing-role reconstruction, or new memory; preserve the existing memory query and task loss.
substantive_difference: Both strategies must solve the coupled saddle system, not two independent attention softmaxes. OTKE minimizes transport cost with fixed marginals; here both opposed marginals are optimized. OptNet has one convex minimization, not an adversarial two-distribution equilibrium. Different proposal/challenge adapters make P generally nonsymmetric; do not replace this with a symmetric skew game or a single robust mean.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Might discourage compositions fragile to competing interpretations of the same evidence; no claim of robustness or performance gain is warranted.
risks: Learned proposal/challenge embeddings may collapse or yield near-uniform strategies
Numerical KKT conditioning; softmax best-response iteration alone is not sufficient evidence of convergence
The minimax discrepancy is an explicit inductive bias, not proof that latent roles are actual adversaries
Original NumPy/autograd implementation requires an independent modern implementation; no dependency installation authorized

title: Neural Enhanced Belief Propagation on Factor Graphs
source_evidence: Read PDF section 4.1 Table 2, section 4.2 equation 6 and section 4.3 equation 7. Explicit BP messages are passed into a factor-GNN, then refined multiplicatively and additively before marginal extraction. Searched author GitHub repositories; vgsatorras/hybrid-inference is an earlier Kalman/graphical-model work, not verified NEBP code. The guessed NeuralEnhancedBP URL failed. No author implementation is claimed verified.
mechanism: Alternate analytic variable/factor sum-product belief propagation with a learned factor-GNN that observes directed BP messages and supplies positive message refinements; read out beliefs from products of incoming messages.
osram_mapping: Represent discrete latent states of the active Local/Base/Gap roles with learned unary and pairwise/ternary factors. Run genuine sum-product updates with recipient exclusion plus factor-GNN correction, then decode marginals into role updates. No state labels, absent-role inference, extra regularizer, or changed memory query. Original paper uses supervised beliefs and a correction regularizer; whether task-only training preserves a useful hybrid is unresolved.
substantive_difference: CRF-RNN uses mean-field factorized expectations; NEBP preserves directed cavity messages and analytic sum-product factor elimination before neural correction. Plain factor-node message passing would collapse into existing hypergraph/RRN families and is not accepted.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Joint factor beliefs might expose contradictions missed by independent mean-field role beliefs; hypothesis only.
risks: Author code not located: pending
Original extra correction penalty conflicts with fixed-loss protocol and must not be silently retained
Graphs with at most five roles may be too small to justify approximate inference
Loopy BP stability

title: Differentiable Dynamic Programming for Structured Prediction and Attention
source_evidence: Read PDF sections 2.2–2.3, recursion equation 6, Proposition 2, and section 3.1 distinction between local regularized DP and globally regularized inference. Read complete author reference/viterbi.py viterbi_grad and viterbi_hessian_prod (Algorithms 3/4). Pin 180eb9e0904f153dc6176fe76b95d7c4d3e8c1bf.
mechanism: Replace each max in a DAG dynamic program with a strongly-convex-regularized maximum; compute the relaxed path via reverse recursion and differentiate it with a Hessian-vector recursion.
osram_mapping: Potentially use a finite-state evidence-composition grammar whose transitions consume active roles once and carry a nontrivial composition state; DP transition marginals drive existing-role updates before Flat. Preserve input roles, memory query and task loss. Pending a meaningful state/constraint definition: the at most five roles must not be falsely treated as a temporal sequence or expanded into arbitrary feature-order tokens.
substantive_difference: Locally regularized Bellman recursion is not SparseMAP's global Euclidean projection; the paper explicitly distinguishes DP regularization from global LP regularization. However replacing a global solver or adding a cardinality-only gate is not by itself sufficient OSRAM novelty.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: A valid finite-state composition constraint might make role combinations coherent; currently no grounded constraint justifies an expected gain.
risks: Natural order/state space absent
Could degenerate into primitive selection on at most five roles
May overlap the existing CRF or rule-binding mechanism after adaptation

title: Neural Bellman-Ford Networks: A General Graph Neural Network Framework for Link Prediction
source_evidence: Read original section 3.2 Algorithm 1 and equations 5–6, plus design-space discussion. Read author model.py bellmanford/forward and complete layer.py GeneralizedRelationalConv message, aggregate, fused message_and_aggregate and combine. Code explicitly reinjects graph.boundary at every step, conditions relation transforms on graph.query, and returns source-conditioned destination representations. Author pin eb49ff2770d1629edb04e96c9a6d7fee809097f2. Also inspected historical meaningful_new40_structure.py NestedGNN.forward lines 323–348: root/distance embeddings, induced-adjacency GIN-style aggregation and pooled rooted states, with no persistent source boundary or relation-query-conditioned path extension.
mechanism: Source/query-conditioned generalized Bellman-Ford recurrence with a source-only initial indicator, query-conditioned relational path extension, aggregation over competing walks and boundary reinjection at every step.
osram_mapping: Build a per-example graph on Local256, Base512 and only the active subset of Gap1/2/3_512. Role adapters supply content descriptors; directed role-pair identities define relation types, while bounded pairwise edge weights depend on current endpoint descriptors. For every source role s, seed h_s^0 with its content query and all other h_v^0=0. Each step injects that same boundary into the relation-conditioned generalized Bellman-Ford update. Preserve source-to-destination states rather than collapsing roots early: a target role receives separate direct and multi-step path-informed descriptors from all active sources, decoded into its existing Flat input. An example is Local->Base->Gap2 versus Local->Gap1->Gap2. This is within-example evidence composition, not historical or causal discovery. Memory read/write query and sole task loss remain unchanged; no link prediction labels/negative samples.
substantive_difference: Historical NestedGNN initializes all nodes with content plus a root marker, runs an untyped induced-graph recurrence, and pools each root subgraph. NBFNet instead preserves source-indexed destination states, a source-only boundary reinjected each step, and query-conditioned relation-specific path extension. Historical PPGN multiplies two nonlinear full pair-state tensors; here a source-destination state extends through typed edges under the retained boundary condition. PNA may be reused only as the aggregation subcomponent, never counted as the novelty.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Could distinguish direct Local-to-Gap evidence from Base-mediated support paths; small-role-graph utility is untested.
risks: Few roles mean only short composition routes; longer walks are not automatically useful
Repeated walks may reinforce noise
Node permutations must carry Local/Base/Gap identities and masks consistently
Neural operators relax semiring assumptions; do not claim exact shortest-path guarantees or causal inference

title: Graph Transformer Networks
source_evidence: Read original section 3.2 Meta-Path Generation: soft convex selection of typed adjacency matrices followed by matrix-product relation composition. Read complete author prev_GTN/model.py GTConv.forward, GTLayer.forward, GTN.normalization/gcn_conv/forward. First GT layer computes bmm(a,b), later layers bmm(previous,a); learned channels feed graph convolution. Current model_gtn.py also opened; no FastGTN variant counted separately. Master not pinned.
mechanism: Learn mixtures of edge-type adjacency matrices, compose them multiplicatively into meta-path graphs, normalize those learned graphs and convolve original node features over each graph channel.
osram_mapping: Use active role vectors as node contents and directed role-pair incidence matrices plus identity as candidate relation types; learn complete meta-path graphs, propagate contents with the source normalization and concatenate graph-channel outputs before existing Flat. Remove inactive Gap rows/columns. Memory query and task loss stay unchanged. Conditional because with only one node per role, meta-path basis matrices can collapse to a fixed dense linear role-mixing matrix.
substantive_difference: PPGN carries feature-valued pair states and multiplies independent nonlinear transforms; GTN composes convex mixtures of typed adjacency operators before node convolution, while EGT updates edges by attention and DiffPool contracts nodes. These are not identical algorithms. Nevertheless, the scoped tiny-graph specialization may erase the distinction and must be checked rather than automatically accepted.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Typed direct versus mediated evidence routes might supply an appropriate relation prior; no gain established.
risks: Could algebraically reduce to learned fixed linear mixing on this tiny role graph
Inventing content-based edge types changes the original input contract and needs explicit design justification
Meta-path multiplication alone is not enough to distinguish from historical PPGN

title: Differentiable Learning of Logical Rules for Knowledge Base Reasoning
source_evidence: Read original equations 6–11 and Algorithm 1: operation attention, attention over prior partial-inference vectors, END-step rule-length selection and rule extraction. Read complete author src/model.py Learner._build_graph, including one-hot seed, operator/transposed-operator application, growing within-proof tensor and final memory read. Pin 239af3bc907c3d785a3fc033a05df23ea786c42f.
mechanism: A recurrent controller chooses relation operators and earlier partial proof distributions, composing weighted variable-length first-order relation chains; final attention selects rule lengths. Intermediate states are distributions over entities, not unconstrained feature vectors.
osram_mapping: Entities are exactly active Local/Base/Gap1/2/3 roles. A shared current-pair encoder constructs a small bank of nonnegative directed latent relation matrices M_k from existing descriptors, each masked to active endpoints; include their transposes as in author code. For source role s, u0=e_s. Feed a source-content-plus-learned-query embedding into the controller, compute u_t=sum_k a_tk M_k(sum_tau b_ttau u_tau), and retain final END attention over all inference depths. Use destination distributions for source-specific descriptor composition before existing Flat. The u_0..u_T tensors exist only within one forward call and are discarded; no historical cache or causal-memory replacement. No relation, rule, or endpoint labels and no extra loss.
substantive_difference: NPS binds and executes one rule/entity update; NLM transforms an arity lattice. MAC stores dense feature summaries, not source-to-destination distributions produced by typed relation operators. NBFNet recurrently extends path features with fixed source-boundary reinjection; NeuralLP instead attends to every earlier proof distribution and explicitly mixes rule lengths. GTN's global fixed adjacency mixtures lack this content-conditioned recurrent operator/history selection. Replacing the proof-distribution recurrence with ordinary attention invalidates the transfer.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Might select when one-hop versus mediated relations among the current evidence roles are useful; untested.
risks: Learned relation matrices are latent and must not be presented as verified semantic facts
Few active roles may make long chains redundant
Temporary proof-state storage is allowed only within the forward computation
Original Python2/TensorFlow1 code is reference-only

title: End-to-End Differentiable Proving
source_evidence: Read original sections 3.1–3.4: differentiable unification, OR/AND recursion, symbolic substitutions and proof aggregation. Read author ntp/prover.py unify/batch_unify, substitute, or_, and_, aggregate_proofs and prove; read complete nunify.py representation_match. Actual default code uses exp(-Euclidean distance) with distance clipping, and combines proof steps by minimum. experiments/learn.py max-aggregation configuration and optional neural-link-predictor paths inspected; no joint predictor/loss is included in transfer. Pin 23687f5ccbb089ed78b4bcef5d055091408ee8d2.
mechanism: Backward-chain a finite rule program with explicit variable substitution; compare predicate/constant embeddings using the source soft-unification kernel; combine a proof's matches by minimum and alternate proofs by maximum.
osram_mapping: Role identifiers are constants for current active Local/Base/Gap1/2/3 only. Encode each ordered observed-role pair as a fact predicate embedding, conditioned on its two existing descriptors; facts have these role constants as arguments. Learn predicate embeddings in generic two-body Horn templates p(X,Y):-q(X,Z),r(Z,Y), allowing exact shared-variable binding. For learned query predicates and each active source/target, search bounded proof trees using source AND/OR/unification, then decode the collection of proof scores and role values into updated Flat inputs. Content-conditioned symbol embeddings replace static lookup embeddings at the boundary; the prover is unchanged. No external knowledge base, truth labels, missing-role facts, ComplEx companion, extra loss or persistent proof cache; memory query stays untouched.
substantive_difference: Explicit substitution consistency and soft symbol unification across branching backward proofs differ from NLM arity operations, NPS execution routing and SATNet global clause optimization. NeuralLP sums linear-chain operator walks with controller attention; NTP searches rule/body proof trees with shared variable bindings and max-min matching. A bare kernel similarity or max pooling over pairs would not preserve NTP.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: Could represent 'one common intermediary supports two relations' with consistent role binding, instead of combining unrelated pairwise matches; no performance claim.
risks: Max/min gradients are sparse and ties need deterministic handling
Unsupervised latent predicate meanings are not automatically interpretable
Content-conditioned symbol embedding is an explicit front-end adaptation, not a reproduction of original KB benchmarks
Proof templates/depth must remain fixed without label-dependent rule construction

title: DeepProbLog: Neural Probabilistic Logic Programming
source_evidence: Read original sections 3–5, possible-world probability, neural annotated disjunctions, four-stage grounding/logic rewriting/SDD/evaluation pipeline, and gradient-semiring equations. Read complete author arithmetic_circuit.py, engines/exact_engine.py and semiring/graph_semiring.py: LogicDAG to SDD, neural predicate evaluation, exact plus/times/negation, differentiable neural weights. Pin f64181f66a3a789a96a47d7c2d3fae4d56178990. Underlying PySDD compiler internals not inspected.
mechanism: Predict probabilities of shared neural facts, ground logical queries, compile their Boolean dependencies into deterministic decomposable decision diagrams, and exactly sum possible-world weights with gradients to neural fact probabilities. Overlapping proofs do not become independent events.
osram_mapping: Use current active roles only. Define a small fixed role-support skeleton connecting Local/Base and each active Gap; neural pair encoders produce Bernoulli probabilities for those edges. Query bounded reachability and direct-versus-mediated support between roles, with the SAME edge random variable shared whenever a proof reuses an edge. Compile the finite query formula to an SDD/decision diagram, evaluate exact probabilities per example, and decode query-marginal-weighted role descriptors into existing Flat inputs. For two proofs a&b and a&c, the union is p_a*p_b+p_a*p_c-p_a*p_b*p_c, not independent-proof noisy-OR. No assertion that these are physical causal edges. No missing-role variables, auxiliary truth labels or probabilistic training loss. Static program topology is not historical data, but neural values/results must be re-evaluated each forward with no persistent sample cache; preserve memory query.
substantive_difference: RAT-SPN marginalizes learned Gaussian scope partitions; DeepProbLog starts from explicit shared logical facts and compiles overlapping derivations so an event is counted once. Differentiable gate networks do not enforce possible-world semantics when inputs are reused. SATNet optimizes satisfaction of clauses, while this computes exact event probabilities; NTP uses best-proof fuzzy scores rather than shared-event marginalization. A product/sum MLP without logical grounding and deterministic disjointization would not qualify.
expected_benefit_hypothesis: May avoid overcounting several mediated paths that reuse the same evidence event, yielding a better calibrated fusion feature; hypothesis only.
risks: Latent independent-edge probabilities are an explicit modeling assumption
Fixed support skeleton may omit useful interactions
Knowledge compilation may grow exponentially; bound edge count and query depth without inventing more tokens
No new dependencies are installed; any implementation requires separate dependency-policy compliance
Compiler internals not audited; no end-to-end code run
